working_definition: P15 'tail' of differentiating neurons attached to the Tm20 cluster; the authors' call is 'probably immature Tm20 neurons'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm20 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hbn/Opa/Slp temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Immature form of the single named type Tm20. Verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a transmedullary neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
